Deep Depression News, No.10, 2026

Issued at 12:00 hours M.S.T on 24-9-2026

 

·             

          According to the observations at 10:30 hrs MST today, the Deep Depression which crossed North Andhra Pradesh and adjoining South Odisha Coasts between Visakhapatnam and Gopalpur close to the Southwest of Kalingapatnam (India) has moved West-Northwestwards and may crossing interior regions of India and then weaken gradually.

 

          This is the last news for the Deep Depression.
